<!--
Experiment pull request: keep every section. Open it as a draft at the first push and keep this
body current: it is the summary of the experiment, not its history. History goes in milestone
comments (one per major step or lesson, never edited afterwards).
Engineering pull request (demo, report, project setup): keep Summary and
Verification, delete the rest.
Merge with a merge commit, so commits cited in an experiment README stay on main.
-->

## Summary

Closes #

## Verification

How this was checked, and what was not checked.

## Approach

What is being run to answer the question, and what changed from the first plan.

## Current answer

Where the evidence points right now. "Not yet known" is a valid entry.

## Findings

What was learned, including what was not asked: side observations, dead ends, things that surprised.

## Knowledge landed

Every finding above goes to exactly one place before this is ready for review; write "none" where nothing applies.

- [ ] Answer and evidence: `experiments/<id>/README.md`
- [ ] Holds beyond this experiment: `docs/`
- [ ] How to work in this repository (tools, Colab, storage): `.agents/knowledge/`, or a skill for a repeatable procedure
- [ ] Answer summary posted on each issue this closes
- [ ] New questions opened as issues

## Compute used

Accelerator, number of runs, approximate compute units (`colab usage`).
